record.original_quote:
We found that for patients diagnosed
with AAH/AIS/MIA by FS, bronchial inflation sign, vascular convergence sign, lobulation sign, spiculation sign, and the
diameter of the nodule are independent risk factors for pathological upgrading.
 When studying IAC patients, those with
nodules ≤ 12.6 mm and CTR ≤ 0.5 are prone to be underestimated during FS diagnosis, perhaps due to their small solid
components, which might be missed during pathological sectioning.
